compiled_state.author: Joe Oakhart
compiled_state.description: Introduce a reduced-depth review tier for low-complexity plans (plan review) and small/mechanical changes (code review), with a classifier or heuristic gate deciding tier and a conservative fallback to full review. Acceptance: tier decision logged per review; gold-set check that lite tier does not miss blocking findings on low-complexity work; unit-cost reduction measured.
compiled_state.title: Add lite review tiers for low-complexity plans and changes
